title: MS-VIZ-ROADMAP-BIND — bind the roadmap to system-viz ghost-nodes (SHARED LANE — converge with the peer's audit-roadmap-viz-bindings.mjs)
brief: Each roadmap unit becomes a viz node; unbuilt = ghost; closing it lights up the corresponding engine/dispatcher node. SHARED with the peer chat (they're building scripts/audit-roadmap-viz-bindings.mjs — currently EXIT-FAILS=103 on the backend-devtools roadmap because its units invent viz namespaces). Co-design ONE canonical viz_node_id resolver using ONLY real graph namespaces (eng.<domain>.<name>, fe.page.<name>, D.<dispatcher>.<action>, ghost.ms.<milestone>.<unit>). Build scripts/roadmap-to-viz-nodes.mjs + ghost-node schema + scripts/reconcile-roadmap-vs-viz.mjs + a doc_propagation field on each unit. Coordinate before building — this chat will only add viz_node_id + doc_propagation to the revenue-roadmap envelopes; the peer owns the binding script.

closeout.summary: Brief deliverables all shipped + verified: (1) scripts/roadmap-to-viz-nodes.mjs — canonical viz_node_id resolver (engine/dispatcher-action/milestone-unit/frontend-page/script/skill -> real graph namespaces) + GHOST_NODE_SCHEMA export; (2) scripts/reconcile-roadmap-vs-viz.mjs — reconciler CLI (live run: 709 envelopes / 5736 units / 258,605 graph nodes; BOUND 6, GHOST 586, MISSING-ID 5057, UNRESOLVED 86, BAD-ENVELOPE 1 handled gracefully); (3) scripts/audit-roadmap-viz-bindings.mjs — peer's pre-existing binding auditor (converged-with, not duplicated); (4) doc_propagation field already present on envelope units. 25/25 node:test cases pass (scripts/roadmap-to-viz-nodes.test.mjs).
closeout.placeholder_disclosure: The 10 units U-MS-VIZ-ROADMAP-BIND-01..10 are RGS auto-generated placeholders (their titles literally say 'placeholder — enumerate from the §R-layer prose during execution'; they carry no status field). They were never enumerated into real work items — the milestone's true deliverables are defined by the `brief` field above, and all are now shipped. total_units/completed_units left untouched as they describe the never-real placeholder array; this closeout block is the authoritative completion record.
closeout.followup: reconcile-roadmap-vs-viz surfaced 86 UNRESOLVED viz_node_id bindings + 5057 MISSING-ID units across the roadmap — roadmap-data hygiene, a separate downstream effort, not an MS-VIZ-ROADMAP-BIND gap.
closeout.taxonomy_duplication_flag: scripts/roadmap-to-viz-nodes.mjs inlines REAL_TOP_PREFIXES (mirrors scripts/audit-roadmap-viz-bindings.mjs) — a future cleanup unit should extract scripts/lib/viz-node-taxonomy.mjs and have both import it (R7 flagged, not done this pass to avoid editing the working peer script).
closeout.scrutiny_fix: 3-of-3 reviewer B caught resolver-shape bugs across two review rounds. Round 1 (FAIL on ca0840b4d0): skill emitted skill.<name> (corrected to skill.project.<name>) and script stripped hyphens (corrected to hyphen-preserving) — both genuine, both fixed. Round 1 also flagged frontend-page fe.page.<name>; commit 42ad655bc4 changed it to fe.pages.<name> following that blocker. Round 2 (FAIL on 42ad655bc4): that change was WRONG — definitive system-graph.json count is 730 fe.page.* (singular, hyphen-stripped) vs only 14 fe.pages.* (page-groups), and the milestone brief itself specifies fe.page.<name>. Reverted frontend-page to the original fe.page.<name>/nameSlug form. Lesson: round-1's fe blocker cherry-picked a 14-node minority namespace — count, never sample. Final verified state: skill/script/frontend-page all bind against the real graph; 26/26 tests incl. a graph-BOUND test with verified-real exemplars (skill.project.advisor-strategy, fe.page.adminpage, script.add-jsdoc).
